description: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE: The Council of Metropolitan Police and Sheriffs (COMPAS) has endorsed Drew Stokesbary in his bid for State Representative. COMPAS represents King County Deputy Sheriffs, Seattle Police Officers, the Seattle Police Management Association, and King County Sheriffs Management.
